image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a metallic green tiger beetle on dry, cracked earth. The beetle has a shiny, iridescent exoskeleton with pale markings on its elytra. Its head is visible with large eyes and mandibles, though partially shadowed. Six legs are present, appearing slender and jointed. Antennae are visible but blend slightly with the background texture.
